   "source": [
    "# Linear Advection\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "b9222d37",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:12.897707Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:12.897523Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.913684Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.912125Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "from landlab import HexModelGrid, RasterModelGrid, imshow_grid\n",
    "\n",
    "parameters = {}   # default for dune component is \"limiter\":\"default\", \"order\":0}\n",
    "if False:\n",
    "    from landlab.components import AdvectionSolverTVD as AdvectionSolver\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    from dune.femdg.landlab import DuneAdvectionSolver as AdvectionSolver\n",
    "    # parameters = {\"limiter\":\"default\",\"order\":1}\n",
    "    # parameters = {\"limiter\":None,\"order\":1}\n",
    "    # parameters = {\"limiter\":None,\"order\":0}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "37724f7f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Advection of a Gaussian \"bump\" in 2d\n",
    "\n",
    "We start by defining a function to make the initial bump, and a function to report the cumulative translation of the peak of the bump."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "e41ad9db",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.915704Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.915342Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.919719Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.918883Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def make_gaussian_bump(grid, field, width, center=[0.5,0.5]):\n",
    "    midx = 0.5 * np.amax(grid.x_of_node) - 0.5 + center[0]\n",
    "    midy = 0.5 * np.amax(grid.y_of_node) - 0.5 + center[1]\n",
    "    dist_sq = (grid.x_of_node - midx) ** 2 + (grid.y_of_node - midy) ** 2\n",
    "    field[:] = np.exp(-0.5 * dist_sq / bump_width)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "3c8bdf24",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.921397Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.921215Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.925204Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.924219Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def calc_translation_distance(grid, elev, x0, y0, u, dt=None, nt=None):\n",
    "    highest_node = np.argmax(elev)\n",
    "    distance = np.sqrt(\n",
    "        (grid.x_of_node[highest_node] - x0) ** 2\n",
    "        + (grid.y_of_node[highest_node] - y0) ** 2\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    print(\"Velocity magnitude is\", u)\n",
    "    if dt is not None:\n",
    "        print(\"Duration is\", dt * nt)\n",
    "        print(\"Predicted distance is\", u * dt * nt)\n",
    "    print(\"Modeled distance is\", distance)\n",
    "    print(\"Min/Max\",min(elev),\"/\",max(elev))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a7070e9a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Raster grid with advection to the east\n",
    "\n",
    "Note that when we instantiate the component, we will leave its value of `advection_direction_is_steady` at the default of `False`. We do this because we are going to reuse the component several times with different advection directions, so we want it to recompute the upwind links."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "f63e038f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.926834Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.926614Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.929832Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.928905Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Parameters\n",
    "nrows = 51\n",
    "ncols = 51\n",
    "ux = 1.0\n",
    "uy = 0.0\n",
    "c = 0.2\n",
    "nnodes = 100\n",
    "ntimesteps = 100\n",
    "bump_width = 0.01  # width of Gaussian bump"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "497c4591",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.931369Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.931193Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.959356Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.958412Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Setup\n",
    "dx = 1.0 / (nrows - 1)\n",
    "u = (ux * ux + uy * uy) ** 0.5\n",
    "dt = c * dx / u\n",
    "\n",
    "# create grid\n",
    "grid = RasterModelGrid((nrows, ncols), xy_spacing=dx)\n",
    "\n",
    "# create fields\n",
    "elev = grid.add_zeros(\"topographic__elevation\", at=\"node\")\n",
    "vel = grid.add_zeros(\"advection__velocity\", at=\"link\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# initialize fields\n",
    "make_gaussian_bump(grid, elev, bump_width,center=[0.25,0.5])\n",
    "maxnode = np.argmax(elev)\n",
    "x0 = grid.x_of_node[maxnode]\n",
    "y0 = grid.y_of_node[maxnode]\n",
    "vel[grid.horizontal_links] = ux\n",
    "vel[grid.vertical_links] = uy"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2e753cc6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "#### Instantiate component"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "8c3b0e69",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.962210Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:15.961798Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:16.925534Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:16.924465Z"
    }
   },

     "output_type": "display_data"

   ],
   "source": [

    "imshow_grid(adv.grid, elev)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "531ed37f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:16.927327Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:16.927107Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:17.272141Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:17.271615Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Velocity magnitude is 1.0\n",
      "Duration is 0.4\n",
      "Predicted distance is 0.4\n",
      "Modeled distance is 0.4\n",
      "Min/Max -7.813540301696116e-11 / 1.0048552954725252\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 320x240 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "for _ in range(ntimesteps):\n",
    "    adv.update(dt)\n",
    "imshow_grid(adv.grid, elev)\n",
    "calc_translation_distance(grid, elev, x0, y0, u, dt, ntimesteps)"
   ]

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Identify places with positive vs. negative x-wise velocity\n",
    "make_gaussian_bump(grid, elev, bump_width)\n",
    "elev0 = elev.copy()\n",
    "vel_is_neg = grid.x_of_node[grid.node_at_link_head] <= 0.5\n",
    "vel[:] = 0.5\n",
    "vel[vel_is_neg] = -0.5\n",
    "vel[grid.vertical_links] = 0.0\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    adv.initial()\n",
    "except:\n",
    "    pass"
   ]

   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A rotating cone"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "5942f59e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T17:04:18.548970Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-20T17:04:18.548521Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-20T17:04:18.690498Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-20T17:04:18.689592Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 320x240 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def make_cone(grid, field, width, center, radius):\n",
    "    midx = 0.5 * np.amax(grid.x_of_node) - 0.5 + center[0]\n",
    "    midy = 0.5 * np.amax(grid.y_of_node) - 0.5 + center[1]\n",
    "    absDist = radius - ( abs(grid.x_of_node - midx) + abs(grid.y_of_node - midy) )\n",
    "    field[:] = absDist[:] / max(absDist)\n",
    "    field[absDist<0] = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "make_cone(grid, elev, bump_width, center=[0.25,0.5], radius=0.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "imshow_grid(adv.grid, elev)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "elev0 = elev.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "ux = 2 * np.pi\n",
    "uy = 2 * np.pi\n",
    "u = (ux * ux + uy * uy) ** 0.5\n",
    "dt = c * dx / u\n",
    "\n",
    "ntimesteps = int(1 / dt)\n",
    "\n",
    "vel[grid.horizontal_links] = - np.pi * (\n",
    "              grid.y_of_node[grid.node_at_link_tail[grid.horizontal_links]] +\n",
    "              grid.y_of_node[grid.node_at_link_head[grid.horizontal_links]] - 1\n",
    ")\n",
    "vel[grid.vertical_links] = np.pi * (\n",
    "              grid.x_of_node[grid.node_at_link_tail[grid.vertical_links]] +\n",
    "              grid.x_of_node[grid.node_at_link_head[grid.vertical_links]] - 1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    adv.initial()\n",
    "except:\n",
    "    pass\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in range(ntimesteps):\n",
    "    adv.update(dt)\n",
    "    if i%400 == 0:\n",
    "        plt.figure()\n",
    "        imshow_grid(adv.grid, elev)\n",
    "\n",
    "if dt*ntimesteps < 1-0.1*dt:\n",
    "    adv.update(1-dt*ntimesteps)\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "imshow_grid(adv.grid, elev)"
   ]
